newsitem.title: USA: BT Office Products names Leonard as CFO.
newsitem.headline: BT Office Products names Leonard as CFO.

text.p: BT Office Products International Inc said Tuesday it named Frank Leonard, the company's controller and chief accounting officer, to succeed John McKiernan as vice president of finance and chief financial officer.
McKiernan will leave the company on or about March 31, 1997 to return to his family and home in New Jersey.
The company also said it is conducting an external search for a chief operating officer for its U.S. operations and expects to have this position filled by mid-1997.
The company also said it was making certain changes in its U.S. organizational structure to enhance coordination and integration of the operations it has acquired over the last several years.
It is organizing its U.S. business operations according to eight geographical areas all of which will be managed as a single integrated operational unit.
BT Office Products distributes office products both in the United States and in Europe.
